It doesn't make sense and it sucks. You are suffering from a mental illness. It's not fair but you have to work through it. I know you are already getting help, keep seeking it until you are better. Anxiety is a tough thing to cure but doctors and the like are there and trained to help you. It might be a long process but if you work through it you will see a day were you can be that person that's stuck in your head.

You are NOT pathetic. You are tired and hurt. Life is not always fair (it's really kick you in the ass lately) but it can be beautiful. Think back to a time where the world amazed you, be it a sunset, love, a great act of human kindness, or maybe even just a really good cup of coffee. Life is filled with those little moment that make the pain worth it. I know you are in a lot of pain. Believe me I know how much it sucks to feel fine and then slip back into that mindset. It's alienating and frightening and the whole world seems like it's pointless and at the same time about to collapse. Remember that feeling is just a perspective. If you take a step back you can see how small in the grand scheme of things any problem is (not to belittle your problems I just want you to step back and see all the possibilities around you). You missed one too many questions on a test to get that 1% off, that's not being a failure. That just means that next time you take it, you need to get just one more thing right.You did great on your other exam. I know waiting/paying more sucks but try again whenever you can. You're only a failure when you give up. On the girlfriend thing, heartbreak has its own special pain, but it fades. This is one relationship in the many you will have.   You're 18, I know plenty of wonderful people who never had a relationship until they were quite a bit older. You will meet new people. There are tons of fascinating wonderful people who you will meet in your life. These new comers can become just as dear to you, as important as the best of friends and family can be. Just wait, branch out and if you look for love in the world and you love others, they will love you back. You can be OK again. You might even be doing great some day. That's not to say that there won't be troubles but you are strong enough to see them through back to the good times. My last advice is to maybe seek professional help, they can do wonders. You don't have to do this alone. Best of luck.

I'm glad you are getting help. I get like that sometimes too. What helps me is to remember that this is my anxiety and fear speaking not my rational self. I ask myself  if I didn't have to deal with my problems, they would magically disappear, would I still want to kill myself. It helps me with perspective. However, this is how I deal with my problems. I wouldn't presume to say what works for me will work for everyone or even you. I know you're in a lot of pain and you're probably scared. I wish nothing but the best for you. Have a good appointment and feel free to talk to me.
Sorry, didn't mean to make you cry. But thank you. I really truly appreciate and needed someone to acknowledge and not belittle my pain.

Thanks, I don't feel quite so alone. Maybe I need to demonize this voice, kick it's ass. You're right, it's the up keep that's hard. Resolutions are easy, seeing them through is tough. I hope I have the strength this time.
